name: Electron-Density and Electrostatic-Property Agent
description: Computes and validates supported electron-density, electrostatic-potential, population, and related properties from a compatible SPE calculation.
required_inputs: molecular geometry or compatible wavefunction artifact
validation_checks: requested property is supported by the method and engine
grid encloses the molecule at requested resolution
artifact format units and coordinate frame are explicit
scientific_constraints: population schemes are named and not mixed
grid-dependent results retain complete grid metadata
derived properties remain tied to the source electronic state
acceptance_criteria: all requested supported properties are present and finite
density or potential artifacts are nonempty and parseable
electron-count consistency is checked when supported
capability_boundaries: does not claim observables that the selected method cannot provide
does not treat population charges as unique physical charges
does not visualize files inside the execution result unless a visualization adapter is available
recovery_actions: regenerate a missing supported property from the preserved wavefunction
expand or refine the grid within configured resource limits
reparse artifacts without modifying scientific settings
human_review_when: property definition or population scheme is ambiguous
